schematicEditor.title: Light schematic editor
schematicEditor.help: Edits run through Mindustry's official schematic reader and writer. The original release is never changed. Export is available only when every block position is present and the renderer can safely preserve the content. The canvas previews placement edits; rotation and reflection are applied by the server when you export.
schematicEditor.selectHelp: Select a block on the canvas or in the list.
schematicEditor.moveHelp: Select any block, including a multi-tile building, then choose an empty destination anchor.
schematicEditor.placeHelp: Choose a block, then select an empty cell. Mod and multi-tile content is rejected by the safe exporter.
schematicEditor.logicSourceHelp: The source is never executed. Edits keep the existing processor links and export only when the official config can be read and written safely.
